relationship_rules.link: Any unresolved side is ambiguous; equal comparable links are resolved negatives; every other comparable change or introduction/removal is admitted.
relationship_rules.face_gen: Not-applicable is negative; unknown applicability or availability is ambiguous; remaining applicable facts are admitted and ordered only by locality, specificity, then stable member key.
relationship_rules.documentation: Run/snapshot/context mismatch or unsupported applicability is unsupported; not-applicable is negative; unknown or contradicted is ambiguous; remaining applicable facts are admitted.
relationship_rules.coverage_gap: Each delivered coverage-gap fact is an unsupported mandatory-evidence ledger member.

independent_derivation.candidate_rule: Admitted and ambiguous decisions retain candidates and hypotheses; ambiguous and unsupported decisions retain abstentions; resolved negatives retain none.
independent_derivation.count_formula: For each series, emitted rows = floor((subject_count - 1) / every) + 1. Pattern index = emission_ordinal modulo pattern_count.
independent_derivation.stream_framing: Each UTF-8 field is framed as eight lowercase hexadecimal byte-length digits, colon, and field bytes. The concatenated field frames form one record, which receives the same outer frame. Record order is header, link, facegen, documentation, coverage-gap; link ordinal equals the zero-based link-series index; documentation records contain applicability, snapshot match, context match, and contradiction only.
independent_derivation.identity_boundary: Population rows remain keyed by kind/series/subject coordinates. Expanded source_fact_id is candidate-{kind}-fact-s{series:D3}-n{subject:D8}; all other product identities remain opaque and excluded.

factual_stream_receipt.record_framing: same framing around concatenated field frames

recipe_relationship.proof: The independently retained recipe fingerprint is identical; no other package oracle or path is referenced.

materialization.method: One factual row was classified and length-framed into SHA-256 at a time; no member or candidate aggregate array was retained.

aggregate_boundary.note: Stress evidence does not request or publish a full candidate aggregate.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Rename run, snapshot, context, configuration, and expansion bindings consistently.
metamorphic_closure.invariant: Population counts, coordinate memberships, and public source_fact_id values remain identical; the header receipt changes because the renamed bindings are factual stream fields.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Reorder JSON object properties without changing factual series or pattern array order.
metamorphic_closure.invariant: The semantic stream receipt, all counts, coordinate membership, source_fact_id values, dispositions, and derived optional ordering remain identical.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Change documentation pattern 0 has_contradicting_evidence from false to true.
metamorphic_closure.expected_change: Exactly 31,250 documentation members change admitted to ambiguous; candidate and hypothesis counts remain 550,000, 31,250 hypothesis states change to needs-input, and abstentions increase from 412,500 to 443,750.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Increase face-gen pattern 0 locality from 80 to 81.
metamorphic_closure.invariant: Candidate membership and disposition counts remain identical; only optional order and the factual stream receipt change.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Append a sparse equal-link series at a fresh kind-local series index.
metamorphic_closure.invariant: All existing coordinate memberships and source_fact_id values remain identical; only predictable new resolved-negative rows are added.

metamorphic_closure.transformation: Change link pattern 1 winning target offset from 1 to 0.
metamorphic_closure.expected_change: Exactly 100,000 link members change admitted to resolved-negative; candidate and hypothesis counts each decrease from 550,000 to 450,000.

same_recipe_proof.method: Exact deep equality of link_series, face_gen_series, documentation_series, and coverage_gap_series after excluding subject_count and expansion_id.

source_fact_identity.series_scope: zero-based kind-local series index padded to three digits
source_fact_identity.subject_scope: emitted subject index padded to eight digits
